beats.visual: Close macro through alloy wheel spokes at a brake rotor in bright daylight, heat shimmer distorting the air off the rotor face, shallow depth of field, no people
beats.narration: One wheel hotter than the rest after a drive?

beats.visual: A brake caliper clamped over a rotor behind the spokes, brushed metal and glinting highlights, moody garage side light, no hands
beats.narration: That can point to a sticking caliper.

beats.visual: Macro on a caliper piston and the edge of a brake pad, brake dust and pad material texture, dramatic raking light, no hands
beats.narration: It keeps pressing the pad on the rotor.

beats.visual: Dolly across a worn rotor face showing blue heat discoloration and light scoring rings, blurred shop background, industrial lighting
beats.narration: Drag builds heat and tugs the car sideways.

beats.visual: Wide shop bay interior with an empty lift and a single rotor resting on a steel bench, warm work lighting, bare walls, no people
beats.narration: One clue, not a verdict, worth checking.
